name: columnValuesToBeAtExpectedLocation
displayName: Column Values To Be At Expected Location
description: This schema defines the test ColumnValuesToBeAtExpectedLocation. Test the lat/long values in a column to be at the specified location in the reference column.

parameterDefinition.name: locationReferenceType
parameterDefinition.description: The type of the location reference column.

parameterDefinition.name: longitudeColumnName
parameterDefinition.description: The longitude column name in the table.

parameterDefinition.name: latitudeColumnName
parameterDefinition.description: The latitude column name in the table.

parameterDefinition.name: radius
parameterDefinition.displayName: Radius (in meters) from the expected location
parameterDefinition.description: The radius in meters from the expected location. The test will check if the lat/long values are within the location + the radius.

parameterDefinition.name: threshold
parameterDefinition.description: Number of failures tolerated before the test is marked as failed. Read as an absolute count or as a percentage depending on `thresholdUnit` (defaults to 0).

parameterDefinition.name: thresholdUnit
parameterDefinition.description: How to read `threshold`: `ABSOLUTE` for a raw count of failures, `PERCENTAGE` for a share of the evaluated rows (defaults to ABSOLUTE).

parameterDefinition.name: dimensionFailurePolicy
parameterDefinition.description: How dimensional results roll up into the overall test status: `OVERALL_ONLY` only looks at the overall result, `ANY_DIMENSION` fails the test as soon as one dimension fails (defaults to OVERALL_ONLY).
